label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, then to URI creation at line 48 ('http://' + host). The getAllByName() check only validates if ANY resolved address is non-private, but if all addresses appear private OR if the check passes, the original host value is used unchanged in the HTTP request. Resolved sink value: http://<user_input>/api - attacker-controlled hostname reaches the outbound HTTP fetch without proper authorization verification.

evidence.note: User param flows to host, then to URI.create('http://' + host) at line 48 - direct path to HTTP client
